introDialogue: The air above the water shimmers...
A graceful figure descends from the mist!
finishingMoveDesc: Typhlosion's flames lit up the whole grove!
defeatText: Latias soared off over the treetops...

environment.description: A secluded grove with a horseshoe-shaped pond ringed by dense trees, small orange flower clusters dotting the grass, and an open grassy clearing at the center.

introDialogue: The waterfall roars louder and louder...
Something enormous is rising behind the falls!
finishingMoveDesc: The sea itself boiled under the volcanic fury!
defeatText: Lugia sank back beneath the pool... and a strange light opened where it had been.

environment.description: A circular stone chamber open to a cave ceiling, with a still teal-toned water pool at the center and jagged rock formations ringing the edges.
